query: Confirm who is currently the Minister of Digital Development of Kyrgyzstan as of April 2026, before liquidation of the ministry

responses.answer:
- **Azamat Zhamangulov (also spelled Azamat Zhamankulov or Azamat Jamangulov) was the Minister of Digital Development and Innovative Technologies of Kyrgyzstan as of late April 2026.** [2]
- He spoke at the Fifth Meeting of Heads of SCO ICT Agencies on April 27, 2026, in Bishkek, under the chairmanship of his ministry. [2][4][6]
- Confirmed in role on April 28, 2026, during SCO events. [4]
- Ministry reorganization (merger with Presidential Affairs Department) signed by President Japarov around April 30, 2026, but no pre-liquidation successor named. [1][3][5]
